candidate.name: WebAssembly
candidate.reason: The exact Linguist row groups .wat and .wast under a text-highlighting profile. All six specimens contain module forms, and the pinned grammar recognizes WAST test commands. The dated governing core module grammar and the separately scoped interpreter script grammar establish different boundaries. The whole classifier row remains unresolved as a one-to-one language identity link.

review.limits: The row and samples do not establish conformance to one core edition, full WAST scope, browser API equivalence, WASI interfaces or WIT language identity. The WAST scripting surface is established in the pinned highlighter and reference interpreter. No one-to-one mapping is proposed.
review.scoped_positive_finding: The 2019 W3C announcement directly establishes the separately proposed core WebAssembly programming language identity. The pinned classifier row demonstrably refers to related text artifacts.
